name: Facebook Live
strategic_objective: Real-time connection, Q&A, launches, and community-building through unedited interaction.

tone: Human, direct, and responsive. Less polished than feed content, but still on-brand and structured.
copywriting_rules: The title and description should clearly state the topic, who it is for, and what viewers will gain. Keep the description concise and outcome-focused. During the Live, repeat the topic and CTA regularly for people who join late.
Title: clear topic and benefit. Description: 2–4 short lines explaining what, who, and why now. Include a single primary CTA.
Support late joiners and highlight key points.
Use pinned comments to restate topic and CTA
Use short on-screen labels for segments if using external tools
Avoid cluttering the screen with too much text
Focus on topic and series consistency rather than volume.
Tag guests, partners, or co-hosts in the announcement and recap posts to extend reach.

required_generation_elements: Single main CTA repeated during the session
Opening hook explaining what viewers gain by staying
hard_constraints: Long periods of silence or idle time
Clickbait titles unrelated to the actual content
Aspect ratio MUST be 9:16 for mobile-first, 16:9 if streaming from desktop.
